translations.web: But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
translations.bsb: But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”
translations.kjv: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
translations.asv: But my righteous one shall live by faith: And if he shrink back, my soul hath no pleasure in him.
